items.text: Nwoke ahụ m hụrụ ụnyaahụ bụ onye nkuzi anyị.

translation_en.text: The man I saw yesterday is our teacher.

pattern.description: Relative clause follows the noun + demonstrative.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọ bụrụ na mmiri zoo, anyị agaghị aga.

translation_en.text: If it rains, we will not go.

items.label: beta
items.text_original: Ọ bụrụ na mmiri ezo, anyị agaghị aga.

items.text: Biko nyere m aka.

translation_en.text: Please help me.

items.label: beta

items.text: Otú ọ dị, gọọmentị kwuru na ha ga-aga n'ihu.

translation_en.text: However, the government said they will continue.

items.label: beta

items.text: O were akwụkwọ ahụ bịa.

translation_en.text: He brought that book.

items.label: beta

items.text: N'uche m, agụmakwụkwọ n'efu enyerela ọtụtụ ụmụaka aka.

translation_en.text: In my view, free education has helped many children.

items.label: beta

items.text: Echeghị m na atụmatụ a ga-aga nke ọma ma ọ bụrụ na ndị mmadụ akwadoghị ya.

translation_en.text: I don't think this plan will succeed if the people don't support it.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ekwenyere m gị ntakịrị, mana ọ bụghị kpam kpam.

translation_en.text: I agree with you a little, but not completely.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọ dị ka ọnụ ahịa nri ga-aga n'ihu na-arị elu n'afọ a.

translation_en.text: It seems food prices will keep rising this year.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọ dị mkpa ịnụ akụkụ abụọ tupu e kpebie.

translation_en.text: It is important to hear both sides before deciding.

items.label: beta

items.text: Nwata akwụkwọ nke meriri ihe nrite bụ nwanne m nwanyị.

translation_en.text: The student who won the prize is my sister.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ụlọ anyị wuru n'afọ gara aga ka erela.

translation_en.text: The house we built last year has been sold.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ndị bi n'obodo mepere emepe na-akwụ ụgwọ ụlọ dị elu.

translation_en.text: People who live in the city pay high rent.

items.label: beta

items.text: Akwụkwọ ị gbaziri m na-atọ ụtọ ịgụ.

translation_en.text: The book you lent me is enjoyable to read.

items.label: beta

items.text: Onye nkuzi na-akụziri anyị mgbakọ na mwepụ siri ike.

translation_en.text: The teacher who teaches us maths is strict.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọ bụrụ na ị bịa n'oge, anyị ga-eso aga.

translation_en.text: If you come early, we will go together.

items.label: beta

items.text: A sị na m nwere ego, m gaara azụta ala.

translation_en.text: If I had money, I would have bought land.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọ bụrụ na i risịghị nri nke ọma, ị ga-ada mba.

translation_en.text: If you don't eat well, you will become weak.

items.label: beta
items.text_original: Ọ bụrụ na i righị nri nke ọma, ị ga-ada mba.

items.text: Mgbe m rutere, ha apụọla.

translation_en.text: When I arrived, they had left.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọ na-agụ akwụkwọ mgbe ọkụ latara.

translation_en.text: He was reading when the light went off.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọ bịabeghị n'ụlọ.

translation_en.text: He hasn't come home yet.

items.label: beta

items.text: Agabeghị m Enugwu.

translation_en.text: I have never been to Enugu.

items.label: beta

items.text: Nke mbụ, ka anyị lee nsogbu ahụ anya.

translation_en.text: First, let us look at the problem.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọzọkwa, ego ụgbọ ala arịgoola.

translation_en.text: Moreover, transport fares have risen.

items.label: beta

items.text: N'ihi ya, anyị chọrọ atụmatụ ọhụrụ.

translation_en.text: Therefore, we need a new plan.

items.label: beta

items.text: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọtụtụ ụlọ akwụkwọ enweghị ọba akwụkwọ.

translation_en.text: For example, many schools have no library.

items.label: beta

items.text: N'ikpeazụ, nzukọ ahụ biri n'udo.

translation_en.text: Finally, the meeting ended peacefully.

items.label: beta

items.text: Biko, gbaghara m maka ịbịaghị n'oge.

translation_en.text: Please forgive me for coming late.

items.label: beta
items.text_original: Biko, gbaghara m maka ịbịa n'azụ oge.

items.text: Ị nwere ike inyere m aka bulie ibu a?

translation_en.text: Can you help me carry this load?

items.label: beta

items.text: Nnọọ, mee ka ọ dị gị ka ọ bụ n'ụlọ gị.

translation_en.text: Welcome, make yourself at home.

items.label: beta

items.text: Daalụ maka ọbịbịa gị.

translation_en.text: Thank you for your visit.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ndo maka ọnwụ nke nna gị.

translation_en.text: Sorry for the death of your father.

items.label: beta

items.text: Achọrọ m ọrụ e boro n'akwụkwọ akụkọ.

translation_en.text: I want the job advertised in the newspaper.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ụgwọ ọnwa m ezughị ịkwụ ụgwọ niile.

translation_en.text: My monthly pay is not enough to pay all the bills.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ahụ ọkụ na-eme m kemgbe ụnyaahụ.

translation_en.text: I have had a fever since yesterday.

items.label: beta

items.text: Anwụnta na-ebute ịba.

translation_en.text: Mosquitoes cause malaria.

items.label: beta

items.text: Otu ụbọchị, otu dinta gara n'ọhịa naanị ya.

translation_en.text: One day, a hunter went to the forest alone.

items.label: beta

items.text: Na mberede, ọ nụrụ olu dị iche.

translation_en.text: Suddenly, he heard a strange voice.

items.label: beta

items.text: N'ikpeazụ, ndị obodo hụrụ ya.

translation_en.text: In the end, the villagers found him.

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọjị bụ ihe mbụ a na-enye ọbịa n'ala Igbo.

translation_en.text: Kola nut is the first thing offered to a guest in Igboland.

items.label: beta

items.text: Onye kacha okenye na-agọzi ọjị tupu a nyawaa ya.

translation_en.text: The eldest person blesses the kola before it is broken.

items.label: beta

items.text: A naghị eji aka ekpe anara okenye ihe.

translation_en.text: One does not receive things from an elder with the left hand.

items.label: beta

items.text: Iri ji ọhụrụ bụ mmemme ekele maka owuwe ihe ubi.

translation_en.text: The New Yam festival is a thanksgiving for the harvest.

items.label: beta

items.text: Obi ya dị ọcha.

translation_en.text: He is sincere (lit. his heart is clean).

items.label: beta

items.text: Ọ gbara ọsọ ndụ.

translation_en.text: He ran for his life.
